Retail Identifier & Operations Guide

iPad Setup & Staff Field Operations • 360 Davenport Rd, Toronto

This handbook guides studio team members on setting up and operating The Practice retail identification tool and Point of Sale companion on studio iPads.

⚡ Tap / Click this after reading the instructions to open up the website
Open The Practice Retail Web App ↗

iPad Standalone Web App Setup (60 Seconds)

Follow these steps once on each studio iPad to install The Practice as a permanent, full-screen home screen app:

1
Open in Safari

Launch Safari on the store iPad and tap the button above or visit
https://itsmcmurdoj.github.io/ThePracticeRetailTool/.

2
Tap Share Icon

Tap the Share button (box with an upward arrow [↑]) located in Safari's toolbar.

3
Add to Home Screen

Scroll down the sharing options and select "Add to Home Screen" (the [+] icon).

4
Verify App Icon

Confirm the icon shows the official white block with The Practice and 3 stars. Title is "The Practice".

5
Tap "Add"

Tap Add in the top-right corner. Safari will close and place the app icon directly on the iPad home screen.

6
Launch & Go

Tap the new icon to launch in full-screen standalone mode without any browser tabs, URL bars, or distractions.

⚠️ Mandatory Step: Install the Moments HTML Web App
Do Not Use App Store

Studio iPads run operational tools as HTML web apps. Each iPad must have the Moments web app installed by navigating to https://momence.com in Safari, tapping Share > Add to Home Screen, and naming it Moments. Do NOT download or use the customer-facing Momence app from the App Store (which is only for client bookings)—all register links in The Practice open the Moments web app directly.

Core Workflows

Retail Identification & Knowledge Engine

Designed for front-desk staff to instantly recognize barcodeless items, access craftsmanship notes, and engage guests with confidence.

Vision AI Engine

AI Photo Search & Reverse Match

Perfect for small, barcodeless boutique items like Ariana Ost crystals, Fernand Petal body oils, and Cape Diablo jewelry.

  • Open Camera: Tap the central camera view on the home screen.
  • Center & Snap: Hold the item in front of the iPad lens and tap "Snap & Identify".
  • Neural Match: MobileNet extracts a 1,024-dimension vector and compares it against The Practice catalog within 200 milliseconds.
  • Confidence HUD: View high-confidence match percentage (e.g. 96%) and top alternative candidates.
Boutique Directory

731-Product Master Catalog

Instant visual directory with high-resolution photography, categorized by brand, scent, and department.

  • Brand Filtering: Filter instantly by Ariana Ost, Bradley Mountain, Cedar & Myrrh, Culti Milano, Lola Blankets, and more.
  • Keyword Search: Search by fragrance notes (e.g., "Lavender", "Sandalwood"), crystal type, or department.
  • Craftsmanship Pitching: Open any product card to see staff talking points with one-tap "Copy Pitch" for client messaging.
  • Instant SKU Copy: Tap the SKU badge to copy the exact product number directly to the iPad clipboard.

Staff Retail Etiquette & Talking Points

When guests express curiosity about an item on the boutique shelves, follow this simple 3-step ritual:

1. Identify & Verify:

Snap the item or filter by brand to confirm exact scent profile, crystal type, and retail price.

2. Share Craftsmanship:

Read the talking points note: highlight organic cold-pressed oils, hand-poured wax, or ethical sourcing.

3. Seamless Ring-Up:

Tap "Sell in Moments POS" to transfer directly into the Point of Sale web app register with zero manual typing.

POS & Sales

Point of Sale & Studio Membership Sales

Seamlessly bridge retail item discovery and membership sales directly into the Moments POS web app register on the studio iPad.

Point of Sale Integration

Sell in Moments POS Flow

One tap opens the Moments POS web app register ready to sell to the guest.

⚡ How Point of Sale Ring-Up Works:
Tapping "Sell in Moments POS" opens https://momence.com/dashboard/200431/point-of-sale in a new tab with holding profile Cafe Cafe (cafe@thepractice.ca) pre-selected and the scanned item auto-loaded into the cart!
  • Holding Profile Auto-Routed: Moments POS requires a customer profile before adding items. The tool automatically routes through Cafe Cafe (cafe@thepractice.ca); staff simply switch the customer to the guest at checkout.
  • Fast-Fill Clipboard Chips: Tap the fast-fill chips in the product modal to copy cafe@thepractice.ca or the product SKU to the iPad clipboard anytime.
  • Web App Login: Uses the Moments HTML web app session where studio credentials remain permanently logged in.

Quick Staff Troubleshooting (iPad Front Desk)

Camera Not Prompting?

Go to iPad Settings > Safari > Camera and ensure it is set to Ask or Allow.

Moments POS Doesn't Open?

Verify the Moments HTML web app is saved to the Home Screen from Safari (not the App Store customer app) and logged in.

Updating the Catalog:

Pull down to refresh the page. The service worker automatically downloads the latest updates in the background.
